question: Who among the following Indian athletes set a new national record in the men's 5,000 m event at Boston University in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gulveer Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Indian long-distance runner **Gulveer Singh** set a new **national record** in the **men’s 5,000 m** event in **January 2025**.
 
• He achieved this feat at the **John Thomas Terrier Classic** meet held at **Boston University**, **USA**.
 
• **Gulveer Singh** clocked a time of **13 minutes and 11.82 seconds**, significantly improving upon the previous record. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
 
• The previous national record was also held by **Gulveer Singh** himself, which was **13:18.92**, set at the **Tenman Track Series** in **California** in **March 2024**.
 
• Before **Gulveer's** recent dominance, the **5,000 m national record** was held by **Avinash Sable** (13:19.30).
